announcements.headline: Update re Financial Results
announcements.insight: Special administrators were appointed in October, indicating insolvency. This update re financial results follows that administration.

announcements.headline: Jarvis Securities
announcements.insight: Special Administrators were appointed in October 2026, indicating insolvency proceedings. This follows an update in August and a General Meeting in May.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Special Administrators
announcements.insight: Jarvis Securities has entered special administration following its August update. This insolvency event likely results in total loss of equity value for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Update re Jarvis Investment Management Limited
announcements.insight: Jarvis Securities provides an update on Jarvis Investment Management Limited following the May 2026 GM results. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding this subsidiary.

announcements.headline: Result of GM
announcements.insight: Jarvis Securities announces the result of a GM. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the outcome and any resulting actions.
